QUOTE: On the assembly path that is `asm volatile("" : [x] "+r"(x))`, a no-op the optimizer cannot see through, so it cannot prove the value at compile time and cannot turn a select back into a branch.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows the empty asm volatile with a "+r" input-output operand, calls it a no-op, and says it hides the value from the optimizer, which is the barrier role.
